symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two integers being multiplied.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the number of bits in each of the two integers being multiplied, and the time is the worst-case number of steps over inputs of that length.

relations.quote: The conjecture is posed for multitape machines and is contrasted with the [fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md), in which the target result is measured.
